title: Objectwise Brown Hom representability for locally small categories
statement: Fix a universe $w$. Let $C,D$ be triangulated categories [def-weil-triangulated-category], with arbitrary object and Hom universes, such that every Hom set is equivalent to a type in universe $w$. Suppose both categories have coproducts indexed by types in universe $w$, and $C$ is compactly generated relative to those coproducts [def-pc-compactly-generated]. Let $F:C\to D$ be exact and preserve every such coproduct. For any fixed $Y\in D$, the functor $X\mapsto\operatorname{Hom}_D(F(X),Y)$ on $C^{op}$ is representable: there is $G_Y\in C$ and bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_C(X,G_Y)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_D(F(X),Y)$ natural in $X$.

proof.text: Use triangulatedEquivalenceTransfer on the ShrinkHoms equivalences to construct, rather than assume, the zero, preadditive, shift and triangulated structures on the small-Hom models. Transport w-indexed coproducts using Adjunction.hasColimitsOfShape_of_equivalence.

Apply compactGenerationEquivalence to the source equivalence. Compose the inverse source equivalence, F, and the target equivalence; the composite is triangulated and preserves every w-indexed coproduct. Apply brownRepresentabilityRightAdjoint with the Hom and indexing universes equal to w.

Use Mathlib isLeftAdjoint_comp_iff_right and isLeftAdjoint_comp_iff_left to cancel the two equivalences. The resulting adjunction for F provides representableBy Y, whose isRepresentable conclusion is the original statement.
